source: data/market_snapshot.json, through the site's own engines (scripts/bot_context.mjs and scripts/signals.mjs)
notes: Every number is computed by the QuantLens engines from the snapshot of the same asOf; each one can be traced on the site.
A value is {"v": ...} or {"na": "<the reason it is not available>"}. Never fill a gap with a guess.
Trend regimes and relative strength describe the past and do not predict returns. Nothing here is financial advice.
Triggers use the Telegram briefing's rules against the previous snapshot; an empty list means a quiet day.
Decision Radar tiers describe the last year on total return, and its stops are volatility-sized risk boundaries at the last close: neither is a forecast or a recommendation.

units.close: the asset's currency (ccy), last completed daily close
units.trend: trend regime label: Uptrend, Extended, Pullback, Recovering or Downtrend
units.rs1m: fraction: (1 + asset return) / (1 + benchmark return) - 1 over 30 days, against 'vs'
units.rotation: quadrant against the S&P 500 in USD: Leading, Weakening, Lagging or Improving
units.beta: ratio against the asset's benchmark, last year
units.var95: fraction: one-day 95% historical value at risk, last year
units.shock: ret: the latest session's simple return; z: its log return over the EWMA volatility known the day before
units.spread: fraction of the price: one tick, the minimum round-trip spread
units.amihud: basis points of price move per US$1 million traded, last 20 sessions
units.adv: average daily traded value over 20 sessions, in 'ccy'
units.stress: three-pillar macro regime: volatility (VIX / VIX3M >= 1.00), credit (US high-yield spread >= 4.5% or 0.5 points wider in 20 sessions), rates (10Y - 2Y < 0, or 0.35 points steeper in 20 sessions with the 2Y lower); 0 flags Calm x1.00, 1 Cautious x1.15, 2-3 Stressed x1.35; pillar values are fractions (0.045 = 4.5%)
units.radar: Decision Radar: tier Healthy (score 3-4), Neutral (2, or 0-1 not yet on three sessions) or Dead Money (0-1 on three sessions); score points on total return: trend, strength vs 'vs' over 3 months ('self': the asset is its own benchmark and needs a positive 3-month return), momentum (1-month return, or volatility < 22% for a yield >= 3.5%), drawdown < 12% from the 52-week high; stops are fractions of the last close (init below, breakeven above, trail below the highest close) with tick-rounded prices in 'ccy'
